ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, on the left side there is a 10Ω resistor and a current source i(t)=sin(1000t) connected in parallel between the upper and lower busbars. On the right side there is a 100μF capacitor connected between the upper busbar and the lower-right node. In the middle there is switch K, connecting the upper busbar and the middle lower node; below there is a complementary switch Kbar, connecting the middle lower node and the lower-right node. In the lower right there is also a branch, composed of a 10Ω resistor and a 5V DC voltage source connected in series between the middle lower node and the lower-right node, with the left end of the 5V source marked positive. Reasoning: The problem states that the initial steady state is K open and Kbar closed. At this time, the lower-right node is short-circuited to the middle lower node through Kbar, so the 100μF capacitor is equivalent to being in parallel with the left-side 10Ω resistor, and is driven by the current source i(t)=sin(1000t). The angular frequency ω=1000 rad/s, R=10Ω, C=100μF, therefore the parallel admittance is Y=1/R+jωC=0.1+j0.1 S. The equivalent impedance Z=1/Y=5-j5=7.071∠(-45°) Ω. Therefore, taking the capacitor voltage according to the polarity of the subsequent 5V source in the figure, there is vC(t)=7.071 sin(1000t-45°) V. After t=t1, K is closed and Kbar is open. In steady state the capacitor is open-circuited, and there is no current in the lower-right 10Ω resistor, therefore there is no voltage drop across this resistor; the left end of the 5V source is positive, so the final DC voltage of the capacitor is 5V. If the capacitor voltage has no transient, then the original voltage of the capacitor at the switching instant must be equal to the new steady-state value, namely vC(t1-)=5V. Therefore 7.071 sin(1000t1-π/4)=5, giving sin(1000t1-π/4)=1/√2. Taking the smallest t1>0, 1000t1-π/4=π/4, therefore 1000t1=π/2, t1=π/(2×1000)=0.0015708 s=1.5708 ms. Rounded to two decimal places, it is 1.57 ms.

图像描述：图中左侧有一个10Ω电阻与一个电流源 i(t)=sin(1000t) 并联在上下两条母线之间。右侧有一个100μF电容接在上母线和右下节点之间。中间有开关 K，连接上母线与中间下节点；下方有互补开关 Kbar，连接中间下节点与右下节点。右下方还有一条支路，由10Ω电阻和5V直流电源串联连接在中间下节点与右下节点之间，5V电源左端标正。

推理：题设初始稳态为 K 断开、Kbar 闭合。此时右下节点通过 Kbar 与中间下节点短接，所以100μF电容等效与左侧10Ω电阻并联，并由电流源 i(t)=sin(1000t) 驱动。角频率 ω=1000 rad/s，R=10Ω，C=100μF，因此并联导纳为 Y=1/R+jωC=0.1+j0.1 S。等效阻抗 Z=1/Y=5-j5=7.071∠(-45°) Ω。所以按图中后续5V源极性取电容电压，有 vC(t)=7.071 sin(1000t-45°) V。

在 t=t1 后，K 闭合且 Kbar 断开。稳态时电容开路，右下方10Ω电阻中无电流，因此该电阻无压降；5V电源左端为正，所以电容最终直流电压为 5V。若电容电压无暂态，则切换瞬间电容原有电压必须等于新的稳态值，即 vC(t1-)=5V。

因此 7.071 sin(1000t1-π/4)=5，得到 sin(1000t1-π/4)=1/√2。取最小 t1>0 时，1000t1-π/4=π/4，因此 1000t1=π/2，t1=π/(2×1000)=0.0015708 s=1.5708 ms。四舍五入到两位小数为 1.57 ms。

For the initial interval, write KCL at the capacitor/top node: C dv/dt + v/10 = sin(1000t), where C=100 microF. Seek the sinusoidal steady-state solution v(t)=A sin(1000t)+B cos(1000t). Substitution gives 0.1(A sin+B cos)+0.1(A cos-B sin)=sin, so A-B=10 and A+B=0, hence A=5 and B=-5. Thus vC(t)=5 sin(1000t)-5 cos(1000t). For the post-switch circuit, determine the equilibrium capacitor voltage from the image: in DC steady state the capacitor is open, the right 10 ohm resistor has zero current, and the 5 V source fixes vC(final)=5 V. To avoid a transient, set the pre-switch capacitor voltage at t1 equal to 5 V: 5 sin(1000t1)-5 cos(1000t1)=5, or sin x - cos x=1. planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use KCL for a parallel RC circuit in the time domain, capacitor voltage continuity, and the criterion that the natural component after switching is zero if the initial state equals the new equilibrium. Use steady-state particular solution v=a sin(1000t)+b cos(1000t).

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：电路图中，上方是一条公共导线；左侧有一个10Ω电阻从上节点接到底部左/中节点，旁边有一个向上的电流源，标注 i(t)=sin1000t。右侧有一个100μF电容接在上节点和右下节点之间。中间有开关K，可把上节点接到底部中节点；下方有互补开关 K̄，可把底部中节点接到右下节点。右下方还有一条支路，从底部中节点经10Ω电阻和一个标注5V、左端为正的电压源接到右下节点。推理：初始时K断开、K̄闭合，因此100μF电容与左侧10Ω电阻、电流源并联。令电容电压为v(t)，按图中初始连接写KCL：C dv/dt + v/10 = sin(1000t)，其中C=100μF。取稳态解 v(t)=A sin(1000t)+B cos(1000t)，代入得 0.1(A sin+B cos)+0.1(A cos−B sin)=sin(1000t)。比较系数：A−B=10，A+B=0，所以A=5，B=−5。因此切换前电容电压为 vC(t)=5sin(1000t)−5cos(1000t)。切换后K闭合、K̄断开；直流稳态下电容开路，右下方10Ω电阻电流为零，图中5V电源使电容最终电压为5V。若电容电压无暂态，则切换瞬间电容电压必须等于新的最终稳态值：5sin(1000t1)−5cos(1000t1)=5，即 sin x−cos x=1，x=1000t1。最小正解为 x=π/2，所以 t1=π/(2×1000)=0.0015708 s=1.5708 ms，四舍五入为1.57 ms。

raw_record.original_question: The circuit shown in the figure is initially in the steady state with the switch \(K\) in open condition and \(\overline{K}\) in closed condition. The switch \(K\) is closed and \(\overline{K}\) is opened simultaneously at the instant \(t = t_1\), where \(t_1 > 0\). The minimum value of \(t_1\) in milliseconds, such that there is no transient in the voltage across the 100\(\mu F\) capacitor, is __ (Round off to 2 decimal places).
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, on the left side there is a 10Ω resistor and a current source i(t)=sin(1000t) connected in parallel between the upper and lower busbars. On the right side there is a 100μF capacitor connected between the upper busbar and the lower-right node. In the middle there is switch K, connecting the upper busbar and the middle lower node; below there is a complementary switch Kbar, connecting the middle lower node and the lower-right node. In the lower right there is also a branch, composed of a 10Ω resistor and a 5V DC voltage source connected in series between the middle lower node and the lower-right node, with the left end of the 5V source marked positive.

Reasoning: The problem states that the initial steady state is K open and Kbar closed. At this time, the lower-right node is short-circuited to the middle lower node through Kbar, so the 100μF capacitor is equivalent to being in parallel with the left-side 10Ω resistor, and is driven by the current source i(t)=sin(1000t). The angular frequency ω=1000 rad/s, R=10Ω, C=100μF, therefore the parallel admittance is Y=1/R+jωC=0.1+j0.1 S. The equivalent impedance Z=1/Y=5-j5=7.071∠(-45°) Ω. Therefore, taking the capacitor voltage according to the polarity of the subsequent 5V source in the figure, there is vC(t)=7.071 sin(1000t-45°) V.

After t=t1, K is closed and Kbar is open. In steady state the capacitor is open-circuited, and there is no current in the lower-right 10Ω resistor, therefore there is no voltage drop across this resistor; the left end of the 5V source is positive, so the final DC voltage of the capacitor is 5V. If the capacitor voltage has no transient, then the original voltage of the capacitor at the switching instant must be equal to the new steady-state value, namely vC(t1-)=5V.

Therefore 7.071 sin(1000t1-π/4)=5, giving sin(1000t1-π/4)=1/√2. Taking the smallest t1>0, 1000t1-π/4=π/4, therefore 1000t1=π/2, t1=π/(2×1000)=0.0015708 s=1.5708 ms. Rounded to two decimal places, it is 1.57 ms.
